content.text:
categorical fields is viable in principle.  F := fiber K Omega satisfies
  F & FintypeCat.incl = (finiteEtale K).iota.op & Phi definitionally at object and morphism
  level (both rfl, confirmed in probes), where Phi S = (S.unop ->_alg[K] Omega), and
  yoneda_preservesLimits is an instance.  Blocking step: the naturality squares of the two
  NatIsos need ConcreteCategory.comp_apply plumbing for the Type-category homs (Type's homs
  are bundled, so rfl/funext do not close them).  If completed, the fields
  preservesPullbacks / preservesFiniteCoproducts / preservesQuotientsByFiniteGroups follow
  uniformly from: P.IsClosedUnder{Co,}limitsOfShape (J^op) (S1745/S1770 + of_equivalence),
  creates{Co,}limitsOfShapeFullSubcategoryInclusion,
  preserves{Co,}limitsOfShape_op, and
  preserves{Co,}limitsOfShape_of_reflects_of_preserves with FintypeCat.incl
  (= forget FintypeCat, which creates finite limits/colimits).
- Environment note: concurrent lake/lean builds by other sessions caused intermittent
  "failed to read file ...olean" errors on this shared workspace; both final builds above
  succeeded on retry (EXIT=0).



## 2026-11-01 S1797: (G3) `monoInducesIsoOnDirectSummand` for finite etale K-algebras, unconditional

- Target: S1793 left the field `MonoInducesIsoOnDirectSummandField K` (Lenstra G3) of
  `PreGaloisCategory ((CommAlgCat.FiniteEtale K)^op)` as the only hypothesis; S1747 reduced it to
  `S1747.EpiSurjective K` + `S1747.SurjectiveSplit K`; S1786 did the categorical transfer.
- **Both algebraic inputs are now proved, unconditionally** (no sorry/admit/new axiom) in
  `tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/S1797MonoSecondActual.lean` (318 lines, SHA256
  `0EF92365C94BA8978F0CAC90CF0E873B4D823E979B86833DCA52390BE14AF817`).
  - `S1797.epiSurjective`: epi of finite etale K-algebras => surjective. Key reuse: Mathlib
    `Algebra.isEpi_iff_forall_one_tmul_eq` and
    `Algebra.isEpi_iff_surjective_algebraMap_of_finite` (`Mathlib.Algebra.Algebra.Epi`).
    Make A a B-algebra via phi; then `Algebra.Etale B A` (`Algebra.Etale.of_restrictScalars`),
    `Module.Finite B A` (`Module.Finite.of_restrictScalars_finite`); test algebra
    `A (x)_B A` is finite etale over K (`Algebra.Etale.baseChange`, `Algebra.Etale.comp`,
    `Module.Finite.base_change`, `Module.Finite.trans`); applying the epi hypothesis to
    `includeLeft`/`includeRight` gives `1 (x) a = a (x) 1`. No product decomposition needed.
  - `S1797.surjectiveSplit`: surjection splits. Product-of-separable-fields decomposition
    (`Algebra.Etale.iff_exists_algEquiv_prod`) + per-component factorization
    (`S1747.exists_factor`) gives an index map `ji : i |-> j(i)` and bijections
    `sigma i : B_{ji} ~= A_i`; surjectivity forces `ji` injective (transport of dependent
    functions along `ji i = ji i'` needs `eqRec_apply`/`eqRec_zero`, both `cases h; rfl`);
    complement `C = prod_{j not in range ji} B_j` and an explicit right inverse of
    `B -> A x C` give the algebra isomorphism.
- Derived: `S1797.finiteEtaleSplit` (= S1786.FiniteEtaleSplit K),
  `S1797.monoInducesIsoOnDirectSummandField` (S1786 shape),
  `..._S1767`, `..._S1793`, and **`S1797.preGaloisCategory : PreGaloisCategory ((CommAlgCat.FiniteEtale K)^op)`
  with no hypotheses** (all five fields actual), plus `S1797.galoisCategory` conditional only on
  the fibre-functor field.
- Verification: from `D:\lean`, `lake env lean -j1 -R 'D:\lean' -o
  .lake/build/lib/lean/tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/S1797MonoSecondActual.olean
  tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/S1797MonoSecondActual.lean` -> EXIT=0; olean 609424 bytes (2026-11-01 02:19:46).
  `#print axioms` for all eight main declarations: exactly `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]`
  (no `sorryAx`). Downstream consumer check `_S1797Check.lean` (imports the olean, applies
  `S1797.preGaloisCategory` and its G3 field at `K = Q`) -> EXIT=0.
- Reusable pitfall (cost several iterations): destructuring `Algebra.Etale.iff_exists_algEquiv_prod`
  and re-registering the Pi-type instances with `haveI`/`letI` produces local instance terms
  (`h i`) that are NOT definitionally equal to the instances the dependent data was elaborated
  with, so `hAidata : forall i, Module.Finite K (Ai i)` no longer typechecks. Workaround used:
  state the product-level lemma `prod_surjective_split` with genuine instance binders
  `[forall i, Field (Ai i)]`, etc., and apply it with `@` supplying the destructured
  hypothesis terms explicitly.
